ledger: Scene: man in white shirt shaving in front of a gilt-framed mirror; real man seen from behind (left), reflection on right. Single tracked object: a small white/silver straight-style razor/blade.
00:00.000-00:01.500 razor: real right hand at chin/jaw; reflection shows white blade in raised hand at chin/upper lip - consistent.
00:01.750-00:02.000 razor: real right hand lifts to cheek/eye area; reflection shows white blade near nose/brow - consistent.

00:02.250-00:04.000 razor: real right hand at temple/brow; the object protruding from the real hand renders dark grey/black (comb-like), while the reflection shows a bright white blade on the forehead.
00:04.250-00:04.750 razor: real hand moves down to cheek/nose; object pale again in both real and reflection.
00:05.000-00:08.500 razor: real right hand at chin/jaw/upper lip; reflection shows white blade in hand at matching positions - consistent.
00:08.750-00:09.000 razor: real right hand at chin shows pinched fingers with no visible blade; reflection simultaneously shows white blade held against cheek.
00:09.250-00:09.750 razor: blade clearly visible again in real right hand (silver handle) and in reflection; ends at upper lip/cheek.
No surfaces, containers or hand-to-hand transfers occur; razor never visibly leaves the right hand.

findings.invariant_violated: continuous chain of custody / reflection-object consistency
findings.description: At 00:08.750-00:09.000 the real right hand at the chin is shown with pinched fingers and no blade visible, while the mirror reflection in the same frames shows the white blade held against the cheek. At 00:09.250 the silver razor is plainly back in the real hand. The razor vanishes from the real hand and reappears with no motion that could hide it, contradicting its simultaneous reflection.

From 00:02.250 to 00:04.000 the object in the real right hand at the temple renders as a dark grey/black comb-like implement, while the mirror reflection in the same frames shows a bright white blade on the forehead. Before and after this span the real-side razor is pale/silver. The object's appearance changes between real and reflection, and against its own earlier and later appearance. Backlighting could account for part of the darkening.
